name: UnblurPic
tagline: Unblur Image Online — Sharpen Photos with AI
description: UnblurPic is an AI photo enhancement tool that unblurs soft, shaky, or compressed images. Sign in, upload JPG/PNG/WebP (up to 20 MB), and the default model runs automatically with no prompts or settings. Compare the enhanced result with the original, then download a watermark-free image. One successful enhancement uses one image credit.
